tools.name: meal_plan_get
tools.description: Shows the meal plan for a date range, including planned calories per day and unscheduled meals. Default: today + 7 days.

from.description: Start date as YYYY-MM-DD, default today

to.description: End date as YYYY-MM-DD, overrides days

tools.name: meal_plan_add
tools.description: Schedules a recipe as a meal. Without a date it goes into the unscheduled pool. mealTime: breakfast, lunch, dinner, snack or togo.

recipeId.description: Recipe ID from recipe_search, recipe_discover or meal_plan_get

tools.name: meal_plan_remove
tools.description: Removes one or more meals from the meal plan (IDs from meal_plan_get).

tools.name: meal_plan_move
tools.description: Moves a scheduled meal to a different date or slot.

tools.name: meal_plan_templates
tools.description: Lists your own weekly templates. With templateId the meals per day are loaded as well (orderDay = offset from the start date, 0 = first day).

tools.name: meal_plan_save_template
tools.description: Saves a date range of the meal plan as a weekly template so it can be applied to any week later. Only recipes are copied; day offsets stay relative to the start date.

tools.name: meal_plan_apply_template
tools.description: Applies a weekly template to the meal plan from a start date. Existing meals are kept; with replace the range is cleared first (existing meals in it are deleted). The template is validated before anything is cleared; if applying fails after the clear, the error lists the removed meals so they can be re-added. Returns the resulting plan.

tools.name: meal_plan_delete_template
tools.description: Deletes your own weekly templates.

tools.name: meal_plan_clear
tools.description: Clears a date range of the meal plan. Without arguments: today + 7 days. With scope "unscheduled" the unscheduled pool is cleared instead - this affects all unscheduled meals at once and cannot be undone.

tools.name: meal_plan_previously_planned
tools.description: Shows meals that have been on the plan before - a pool for a new week without having to search again. Returns recipe IDs for meal_plan_add.

tools.name: shopping_list_get
tools.description: Shows the shopping list with open and completed items, grouped by category.

tools.name: shopping_list_add
tools.description: Adds free-text items to the shopping list, e.g. "2 onions". The server detects quantity, unit and category itself.

addToRecent.description: Remember the items in "recent items" (default true)

tools.name: shopping_list_add_recipe
tools.description: Copies all ingredients of a recipe to the shopping list and merges quantities.

tools.name: shopping_list_update
tools.description: Checks items off, undoes that, or deletes them (IDs from shopping_list_get).

tools.name: shopping_lists
tools.description: Lists all shopping lists of the account, including shared lists.

tools.name: recipe_search
tools.description: Searches your own saved recipes across all collections. Side effect: the term is added to your recent searches (the account keeps the last 5). Restricted to one collection with collectionId. Note: does NOT search the global Samsung Food catalog - there is no API method for that; use recipe_discover to browse or fetch a recipe from a website via recipe_import_url.

tools.name: recipe_discover
tools.description: Returns recipe suggestions from the global catalog for browsing. No search term possible - the API ignores it. Use seed to shuffle the selection.

seed.description: shuffles the selection, e.g. a random number

tools.name: recipe_get
tools.description: Fetches a recipe with ingredients, instructions and nutrition.

tools.name: recipe_similar
tools.description: Finds recipes similar to a given recipe.

tools.name: recipe_import_url
tools.description: Extracts a recipe from any website and saves it to the account. With dryRun it only parses, without saving.

tools.name: recipe_create
tools.description: Creates a custom recipe. With recipeId an existing recipe is overwritten.

ingredients.description: one ingredient per line, e.g. "400 g hokkaido pumpkin"

tools.name: recipe_delete
tools.description: Deletes a custom recipe.

tools.name: collections_list
tools.description: Lists the recipe collections of the account.

tools.name: collection_recipes
tools.description: Shows the recipes in a collection.

tools.name: pantry_get
tools.description: Shows the pantry with storage location, expiry date and daysLeft (negative = expired). Useful to see what needs to be used up before planning.

includeConsumed.description: Also include consumed entries, default false (there can be hundreds)

offset.description: Entries to skip; use nextOffset from the previous page

search.description: Only entries whose name contains this text

tools.name: pantry_add
tools.description: Adds entries to the pantry. IMPORTANT: for ingredients that can go in the fridge OR the freezer (meat, fish, butter), Samsung Food does NOT set an expiry date on its own - pass location here and the shelf life is computed from the food graph (chicken breast: fridge 2 days, freezer 9 months). Ask food_storage_info first if the storage location is unclear. Names that only approximately match a food-graph product (e.g. "oat milk" -> Milk) never get an automatic expiry date; those entries come back with matchedProduct and a warning.

location.description: fridge | freezer | pantry - applies to all listed ingredients

tools.name: food_storage_info
tools.description: Looks up where an ingredient is stored and how long it keeps there - without creating anything. Returns all possible storage locations with shelf life in days and whether the location is ambiguous. exact: false (with a warning) means the name was matched to the closest product, not found as such. Purely local, no API call.

tools.name: pantry_update
tools.description: Changes the expiry date, name or storage location of a pantry entry.

tools.name: pantry_consume
tools.description: Marks pantry entries as consumed, undoes that, or deletes them entirely.

tools.name: api_methods
tools.description: Lists the available gRPC methods of the Samsung Food API, optionally filtered by substring. For everything that has no dedicated tool.

tools.name: api_describe
tools.description: Shows the request and response fields of a gRPC method so that api_call can be used correctly.

tools.name: api_call
tools.description: Calls any gRPC method directly. Use api_describe first to learn the field names. Write methods change real data. Login/session methods (AuthAPI) and account-credential methods (change e-mail, phone or password, delete the account, Samsung account code exchange) are refused. Secrets in results (tokens, auth codes, passwords) are replaced by "[redacted]".

tools.name: account_info
tools.description: Shows your own account with nutrition goals and settings.

tools.name: auth_status
tools.description: Shows whether a Samsung Food login is stored, when it expires and when it was last renewed. Never returns the token itself.

tools.name: auth_login
tools.description: Logs in with a browser session: validates the value, renews it to learn the expiry and stores it. Log in at app.samsungfood.com, run copy(document.cookie) in the DevTools console and pass the result. The value is a session secret: it grants full access to the account.

token.description: Cookie string (document.cookie), bare token, "Bearer <token>" or a "Copy as cURL" command

tools.name: shopping_list_create
tools.description: Creates a new (non-primary) shopping list, optionally filled with free-text items like "2 onions". Returns the new list with its ID for the other shopping_list_* tools (listId argument).

addToRecent.description: Remember the items in "recent items" (default true)

tools.name: shopping_list_rename
tools.description: Renames a shopping list.

listId.description: Shopping list ID from shopping_lists (ids start with 106)

tools.name: shopping_list_delete
tools.description: Deletes a shopping list with all its items; this cannot be undone and affects everyone the list is shared with. The primary list is refused: call shopping_list_set_primary for another list first.

listId.description: Shopping list ID from shopping_lists (ids start with 106)

tools.name: shopping_list_copy
tools.description: Copies a shopping list including its items into a new list (named "Copy of <name>", localized by the server). Returns the new list; rename it with shopping_list_rename.

listId.description: Shopping list ID from shopping_lists (ids start with 106)

tools.name: shopping_list_set_primary
tools.description: Makes a shopping list the primary one. The primary list is the default for shopping_list_get, shopping_list_add, shopping_list_add_recipe and shopping_list_update when no listId is given, so use with care. No-op if it already is primary.

listId.description: Shopping list ID from shopping_lists (ids start with 106)

tools.name: shopping_list_recent_items
tools.description: Items recently used on any shopping list (the suggestion pool of the app). Returns {total, items}; if total exceeds the limit, raise limit (max 100).

limit.description: Maximum number of results, default 50, max 100

tools.name: shopping_list_favorites
tools.description: Favorite shopping items (quick-add pool). Returns {total, items} with the favorite IDs needed by shopping_list_favorites_modify; if total exceeds the limit, raise limit (max 100).

limit.description: Maximum number of results, default 50, max 100

tools.name: shopping_list_favorites_modify
tools.description: Creates, updates or deletes favorite shopping items in one call. ops is a list of {op:"create", name, brand?, comment?, quantity?, unit?}, {op:"update", id, name, ...} (replaces the whole favorite, so repeat the fields you want to keep) or {op:"delete", id}. IDs come from shopping_list_favorites. Returns the created/updated items and deleted IDs.

tools.name: shopping_list_share_link
tools.description: Generates a share link for a shopping list and returns it. Nothing is sent to anyone; passing the link on is up to the user. accessMode in the result shows whether the list is private or public.

listId.description: Shopping list ID from shopping_lists (ids start with 106)

tools.name: collection_get
tools.description: Details of one recipe collection: name, recipe count, accessMode (private | public) and your role (owner | none). Use collection_recipes to see the recipes.

collectionId.description: Collection ID from collections_list (ids start with 105)

tools.name: collection_create
tools.description: Creates an empty recipe collection. It is private unless accessMode is "public". Returns the new collection with its ID; fill it with collection_add_recipes.

accessMode.description: "private" (only you) or "public" (anyone with the link can view)

tools.name: collection_update
tools.description: Renames a collection and/or switches it between private and public. Give at least one of name, accessMode.

collectionId.description: Collection ID from collections_list (ids start with 105)

accessMode.description: "private" (only you) or "public" (anyone with the link can view)

tools.name: collection_delete
tools.description: Deletes a recipe collection. The recipes in it stay saved in the account, they only lose this membership. Cannot be undone.

collectionId.description: Collection ID from collections_list (ids start with 105)

tools.name: collection_copy
tools.description: Copies a collection into a new one (the server names the copy). Returns the copy with its ID.

collectionId.description: Collection ID from collections_list (ids start with 105)

tools.name: collection_add_recipes
tools.description: Adds recipes to a collection (a recipe can be in several collections). Recipe IDs from recipe_search, collection_recipes or recipe_create (ids start with 101 or 107). Only recipes already saved in your account work; others are reported under notSaved (save them first, e.g. with recipe_import_url or recipe_create). Returns {added, unchanged, notSaved, failed}.

collectionId.description: Collection ID from collections_list (ids start with 105)

tools.name: collection_remove_recipes
tools.description: Removes recipes from a collection. The recipes themselves stay saved in your account (verified: even when this was their last collection, for recipes you created; for recipes you did not create, removing the last collection is refused). Recipe IDs from recipe_search, collection_recipes or recipe_create (ids start with 101 or 107). Returns {removed, unchanged, notSaved, failed}.

collectionId.description: Collection ID from collections_list (ids start with 105)

tools.name: collection_share_link
tools.description: Generates a share link for a recipe collection and returns it. Nothing is sent to anyone. If accessMode in the result is "private", the link may not work for others until collection_update sets it to "public".

collectionId.description: Collection ID from collections_list (ids start with 105)

tools.name: meal_plan_note_add
tools.description: Adds a free-text note to a day of the meal plan. Returns the note with its id. Notes are listed under notes[] in meal_plan_get.

tools.name: meal_plan_note_update
tools.description: Replaces date and text of an existing note. Both are always sent: pass the current date to keep the note on its day.

noteId.description: Note ID from meal_plan_get (notes[].id) or from meal_plan_note_add

tools.name: meal_plan_note_delete
tools.description: Deletes a meal plan note. Can be undone with meal_plan_note_undelete as long as you keep the noteId (deleted notes no longer show up in meal_plan_get).

noteId.description: Note ID from meal_plan_get (notes[].id) or from meal_plan_note_add

tools.name: meal_plan_note_undelete
tools.description: Restores a note deleted with meal_plan_note_delete (use the noteId you deleted).

noteId.description: Note ID from meal_plan_get (notes[].id) or from meal_plan_note_add

tools.name: meal_plan_meal_update
tools.description: Updates the content entry of a planned meal. The API only supports two things: isLogged (mark the meal as eaten/logged, or undo that) and, for food entries (kind "food", not recipes), the amount. A recipe in a meal cannot be swapped or rescaled here - remove the meal and add a new one. contentId comes from meals[].contentId in meal_plan_get.

isLogged.description: true = logged as eaten, false = not logged

unit.description: Measure unit name for the amount, e.g. "gram"

tools.name: meal_plan_settings_get
tools.description: Shows the settings of the meal plan: first day of the week and sharing mode (private or public) with the number of collaborators.

tools.name: meal_plan_settings_update
tools.description: Sets the first day of the week of the meal plan (the only meal plan setting the API has). weekStart: monday | tuesday | wednesday | thursday | friday | saturday | sunday.

tools.name: meal_plan_template_list
tools.description: Lists the curated public meal plan templates from Samsung Food (not your own - those are in meal_plan_templates). key "onboarding" groups them by diet, "wellness_tips" by wellness area (sleep, stress, ...). The template ids work with meal_plan_templates (templateId) to see the meals and with meal_plan_apply_template.

tools.name: meal_plan_template_update
tools.description: Renames or re-describes one of your own templates (id from meal_plan_templates or meal_plan_save_template). Only the given fields change; the meals stay as they are.

tools.name: meal_plan_share_link
tools.description: Generates an invite link for the meal plan and returns it. Nothing is sent to anyone - passing the link on is up to you. medium: copy | qr | native_share | email | sms | whatsapp | telegram | facebook | twitter (default copy; qr returns a link meant for a QR code). Whoever opens the link can join the meal plan.

tools.name: account_settings_get
tools.description: Shows the preferences of the account in a readable form: diets, avoidances, cuisines, cooking level, household, units, body data, nutrition goals, meal planning preferences and notification switches. account_info returns the raw account instead.

tools.name: account_settings_update
tools.description: Changes preferences of the account. Only the given fields change (field mask); list fields replace the whole list. This affects recommendations and nutrition goals of the real account - use account_settings_get first. nutritionGoals and emailNotifications are merged with the current values.

diets.description: Diets; allowed: lacto-vegetarian, ovo-vegetarian, ovo-lacto-vegetarian, pescatarian, vegan, vegetarian, low-carb, mediterranean, ketogenic, paleo, dairy-free, gluten-free. The list replaces the current one ([] clears it)

avoidances.description: Allergens/avoidances; allowed: alcohol, caffeine, celery, crustacean, egg, fish, gluten, groundnut, milk, mollusc, mustard, sesame, soybean, sulphites, tree-nut, wheat, lactose, yeast. The list replaces the current one ([] clears it)

nutritionPreferences.description: Nutrition preferences; allowed: healthy, high-protein, low-sugars, low-energy, low-sodium, low-fat, high-fiber. The list replaces the current one ([] clears it)

favouriteCuisines.description: Favourite cuisines; allowed: african, american, asian, australian, british, cajun-and-creole, canadian, caribbean, chinese, cuban, eastern-european, european, french, german, greek, indian, israeli, italian, japanese, korean, latin-american, mediterranean, mexican, middle-eastern, moroccan, portuguese, southern, spanish, tex-mex, thai, vietnamese, world-cuisine. The list replaces the current one ([] clears it)

dislikedIngredients.description: Free-text ingredient names; replaces the list

usageGoals.description: Usage goals; allowed: quick-recipe-ideas, meal-planning, healthier-eating, instant-grocery-lists. The list replaces the current one ([] clears it)

plannedMeals.description: Meal slots you plan: breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks, takeout

proteinRatio.description: Protein share as fraction 0..1; the three ratios should add up to 1

fatRatio.description: Fat share as fraction 0..1; the three ratios should add up to 1

carbohydrateRatio.description: Carbohydrate share as fraction 0..1; the three ratios should add up to 1

tools.name: account_usage
tools.description: Shows how many uses are left of a limited feature: mealplan_template_collections (curated meal plan templates) or hr_tailored_plan (tailored plan). Returns remaining and, when the quota is exhausted, when it is available again.

tools.name: recipe_update
tools.description: Changes fields of one of YOUR OWN recipes (created with recipe_create or imported); everything not passed stays as it is. Passing ingredients or instructions replaces the whole list. Recipes of other users are rejected. The returned recipe.id is the one to use from now on (normally unchanged).

recipeId.description: ID of your own recipe, from recipe_search or recipe_create

ingredients.description: one ingredient per line, e.g. "400 g hokkaido pumpkin"; replaces the list

tools.name: recipe_rate
tools.description: Likes or dislikes a recipe (Samsung Food has a thumbs up/down, no stars). rating is exactly "like" or "dislike"; rating again replaces your previous rating. Only works for public recipes: private recipes (e.g. your own, never shared) are rejected with a moderation error. Returns the review including its ID.

recipeId.description: Recipe ID from recipe_search, recipe_discover or meal_plan_get

tools.name: recipe_review_post
tools.description: Posts your written review of a recipe with optional tags and a like/dislike. Tags are short lowercase words such as delicious, easy, fresh, go-to, spicy, moist, under-30-minutes, makes-leftovers. Public recipes only (private ones are rejected). At least one of text, tags or rating is required. Remove it again with recipe_review_delete.

recipeId.description: Recipe ID from recipe_search, recipe_discover or meal_plan_get

tools.name: recipe_review_get
tools.description: Shows a review. With recipeId: YOUR review of that recipe (null if you have none). With reviewId: that review (the id is in the result of recipe_rate / recipe_review_post). rating is like or dislike.

recipeId.description: Recipe ID from recipe_search; returns your own review of it

reviewId.description: Review ID from recipe_rate or recipe_review_post

tools.name: recipe_review_delete
tools.description: Deletes YOUR review/rating of a recipe (only your own can be deleted). Takes the recipe ID, not the review ID.

recipeId.description: Recipe ID from recipe_search, recipe_discover or meal_plan_get

tools.name: recipe_autocomplete
tools.description: Suggests search terms for a prefix, as the search box of the app does. With includeRecent your own recent searches are mixed in (flagged recent=true). Useful terms can be passed to recipe_search (own recipes) or recipe_import_url.

limit.description: Maximum number of results, default 10, max 50

tools.name: recipe_categories
tools.description: Lists the search categories of the explore page (id, title, image), e.g. chicken, pasta, vegan, under_30_min. type: "featured" = the home grid (default), "all" = the complete list. The titles work as search terms.

tools.name: recipe_smart_collection
tools.description: Smart collections are the automatic recipe lists of the app: made_it, recently_viewed, planned and my_recipes. Without collectionId it lists them (with recipe counts). With collectionId (one of those four ids) it returns the recipes in it, newest first by default, plus the available tags. Use limit and the returned nextCursor (as cursor) for more.

collectionId.description: made_it | recently_viewed | planned | my_recipes; omit to list the collections

limit.description: Maximum number of results, default 20, max 100

cursor.description: nextCursor of the previous page, to get the next page

tags.description: tag names from a previous result, to filter

tools.name: recipe_recommended
tools.description: The personalized recommendation feed of the home screen, recipes only (id, name, image, who posted it). Use limit and the returned nextCursor (as cursor) for the next page; seed shuffles the selection.

limit.description: Maximum number of results, default 20, max 100

cursor.description: nextCursor of the previous page, to get the next page

seed.description: shuffles the selection, e.g. a random number

tools.name: recipe_health_recommend
tools.description: Meal suggestions per day and meal slot that fit the calorie and nutrition goals of the account (see account_info), with the reasons (caloriesMacros, dqsAhei, foodList, mlRerank and their weight). mealTimes: any of breakfast, lunch, dinner, snack, togo (default breakfast, lunch, dinner). Recipe IDs can go to meal_plan_add or recipe_get. For more options for one slot use recipe_health_alternatives.

from.description: First day as YYYY-MM-DD, default today

to.description: Last day as YYYY-MM-DD, default same as from

mealTimes.description: breakfast | lunch | dinner | snack | togo, default breakfast, lunch, dinner

limit.description: Maximum number of results, default 3, max 10

tools.name: recipe_health_alternatives
tools.description: More health-based suggestions for ONE meal slot of one day (the "show other options" of the recommendations). mealTime: breakfast | lunch | dinner | snack | togo. Recipe IDs can go to meal_plan_add or recipe_get.

limit.description: Maximum number of results, default 5, max 20

tools.name: recipe_dish_lookup
tools.description: Dish pages: generic dishes (burger, bread, ...) with typical nutrition per 100 g. Without urlPath it lists the top-level dishes with their urlPath (limit/cursor to page: nextCursor). With urlPath (as listed, e.g. "burger/cheeseburger") it returns that dish with the typical serving size in grams and the nutrition per 100 g.

limit.description: Maximum number of results, default 20, max 100

cursor.description: nextCursor of the previous page, to get the next page

tools.name: recipe_more_from_user
tools.description: Other recipes by the same author as a given recipe. The list is empty when the recipe has no user author (e.g. imported from a website).

recipeId.description: Recipe ID from recipe_search, recipe_discover or meal_plan_get

limit.description: Maximum number of results, default 10, max 50

tools.name: recipe_recent_queries
tools.description: Your recent recipe searches, newest first. Samsung Food only keeps the last 5, and every recipe_search registers its term there.

tools.name: recipe_recent_query_delete
tools.description: Removes one entry from your recent recipe searches (query = the exact text from recipe_recent_queries).

tools.name: food_search
tools.description: Searches the food graph (generic foods and ingredients, not recipes). Returns food IDs for food_get and for meal plan entries. Use limit and the returned nextCursor (as cursor) for more.

limit.description: Maximum number of results, default 20, max 100

cursor.description: nextCursor of the previous page, to get the next page

language.description: Two-letter language code, default: the configured locale

tools.name: food_get
tools.description: Shows one food: its portion sizes (name such as "medium"/"large", grams) and the nutrition per 100 g (Edamam codes like ENERC_KCAL, FAT, CHOCDF, PROCNT). Multiply by grams/100 for a portion. foodId from food_search.

attributeId.description: attributeId of the search hit, if it had one

nutrition.description: include nutrition per 100 g, default true

language.description: Two-letter language code, default: the configured locale

tools.name: food_autocomplete
tools.description: Suggests food names for a prefix (e.g. "ban" gives banana). The names work as input for food_search.

limit.description: Maximum number of results, default 10, max 50

language.description: Two-letter language code, default: the configured locale

tools.name: food_product_search
tools.description: Searches the Foodpedia product encyclopedia (ingredients incl. packaged products). Results are ordered by relevance (there is no sort option). Returns product IDs (upper-case canonical names) for food_product_get. Use limit and the returned nextCursor (as cursor) for more.

limit.description: Maximum number of results, default 20, max 100

cursor.description: nextCursor of the previous page, to get the next page

tools.name: food_product_get
tools.description: Shows a Foodpedia product: category, description, storage location, glycemic index, nutrition per 100 g, grams per unit (piece, slice, ...), suitable diets, tips, substitutes and a few linked recipes. productId from food_product_search or food_product_popular.

productId.description: Product ID (canonical name, upper case) from food_product_search or food_product_popular

tools.name: food_product_popular
tools.description: Lists popular Foodpedia products (turmeric, ...). Use limit and the returned nextCursor (as cursor) for more.

limit.description: Maximum number of results, default 20, max 100

cursor.description: nextCursor of the previous page, to get the next page

tools.name: nutrition_analyze
tools.description: Parses free-text ingredient lines such as "2 cups milk" or "400 g hokkaido pumpkin" into the normalized food (canonical name), category, quantity and unit. Nothing is saved. To get the nutrition of a recognised food, look it up with food_product_get using the canonical name as productId.

items.description: one ingredient per entry, e.g. ["2 eggs", "1 cup milk"]

language.description: Two-letter language code, default: the configured locale

tools.name: foodlog_add_from_meal_plan
tools.description: Logs planned meals as eaten in the food log (so they count towards your nutrition tracking). mealIds come from meal_plan_get. Returns foodLogIds, which foodlog_delete needs to undo it.

tools.name: foodlog_delete
tools.description: Removes entries from the food log (the meal stays in the meal plan). foodLogIds as returned by foodlog_add_from_meal_plan; plain meal IDs from meal_plan_get are accepted as well.
